editorial:
Imagine having your whole world flipped upside down in a single morning. You follow a sweet 8-year-old girl named So-won and her loving parents who are forced to deal with a nightmare after a terrible attack. It is a heavy story, but it is not just about the crime. It is really about how a family sticks together when they feel like they are breaking apart. You will feel the pain and the anger, but you also see a lot of love and patience as the parents try to make their daughter feel safe again.

The acting is what really sells this movie because it feels so real and raw. The way the father tries to hide his sadness to be strong for his daughter is heartbreaking. While the story is slow and very sad, the emotional payoff is huge. You should definitely watch this if you like stories about human strength and recovery.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a focus on healing rather than just revenge. After a long legal battle, the attacker is sentenced to prison. You see So-won slowly starting to smile again and returning to school. The most touching part is when she begins to trust people again, showing that while she will always have scars, she can still find happiness. It wraps up as a win for the family's spirit.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves powerful stories about overcoming tragedy.
